total_categories.description: Total number of needs/categories identified across all buckets

bucket.description: Which tier this need belongs to: essentials (4-6 items, critical/daily), nice_to_haves (8-12 items, standard care/prevention), enrichment (8-12 items, quality of life)

top_family.description: Department-level category. Use established categories as guidance but create custom if needed for this pet's unique needs.

family.description: Specific product family/aisle. Be specific and use established families as guidance, but create custom families for unique needs.

description.description: Comprehensive, detailed description of what this pet needs including specific attributes, formats, sizes, features that would benefit this pet

rationale.description: Why this pet needs this RIGHT NOW in THIS bucket at this specific moment, referencing specific pet characteristics, weather/calendar triggers, standard-of-care reasoning, or quality-of-life benefit

evidence.description: Specific pet metadata, weather alerts, calendar events, or veterinary best practice guidelines that drove this need. Format: 'field: value' (e.g., 'age: X months', 'breed: Y', 'weather: alert_type', 'standard: guideline_description'). Shows what data informed this recommendation.

priority.description: critical=life essentials (food, water, safety), high=important care (health, dental), medium=beneficial (enrichment, comfort), low=optional extras. Generally: essentials→critical/high, nice_to_haves→high/medium, enrichment→medium/low

negatives.description: Allergens and safety exclusions for this need (e.g., chicken, rawhide, small-parts). Can be empty array if none.
